description: When referring to this dataset, please cite the corresponding research article (J. Chem. Phys. 156, 234109 (2022); https://doi.org/10.1063/5.0092063) instead of citing this dataset. This dataset includes the data and figure gnuplot-script files necessary to produce all figures for the article "Real-time non-adiabatic dynamics in the one-dimensional Holstein model: Trajectory-based vs exact methods", J. Chem. Phys. 156, 234109 (2022), with the exception of the "Data from Ref. 87"-lines in Fig. 33 and Fig. 34. These two figures include data from Ref. 87, for which we refer to the authors of that reference. The "data" folder includes the data obtained from our simulations with the various methods presented in the article. See the detailed README.txt within that folder for the structure of the data. The "figure_scripts" folder includes all gnuplot figure scripts to produce the figures of the paper (excluding the "Data from Ref. 87"-lines in Figs. 33 and 34). See the contained README.txt in that folder for more details.
